BiblicalUsage: The word is a heap, a mound, a ruin left standing. Joshua burnt Ai and made it a heap for ever, a desolation unto this day; the Lord says He will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and the city shall be builded upon her own heap; and the city given to idols shall be an heap for ever, never built again.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a heap is what judgment leaves, and a city rebuilt on its own heap is what mercy does.
